onboarding.step1: Pick a provider in Settings -- choose Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama, or run fully offline with WebLLM.
onboarding.step2: Paste your API key (stored encrypted in your browser only).
onboarding.step3: Start chatting -- type or press the mic button to talk. The 3D face syncs with the voice.
onboarding.subtitle: Voice & vision assistant running entirely in your browser
onboarding.title: Welcome to AI Face
sessions.desc: Conversations are saved automatically. Pick one to resume.
sessions.title: Sessions
settings.autoRestoreHint: On load, resume your most recent conversation.
settings.experimental: Experimental -- consumes API quota faster than text chat
settings.feelingHint: Detects the feeling of the words being typed or spoken (English + Arabic) and colors the face accordingly. Louder speech adds a warm glow on top.
settings.geminiNativeHint: Handles audio I/O and speech generation natively -- more reliable across languages.
settings.keyHint: Required for Gemini. Leave empty for Ollama.
settings.lightingHint: Global ambient light tint and brightness.
settings.liveKeyHint: Reuses the Gemini key above if the main provider is set to Gemini
settings.liveTranscript: Show live transcript of the call in chat
settings.liveVoice: Live voice call (Gemini Live API -- WebSocket)
settings.liveVoiceHint: Real-time two-way voice chat: mic stays open and streams audio directly via WebSocket.
settings.micEngineHint: On-device = in-browser Whisper. First use downloads a small model, then it works offline. Audio never leaves your machine.
settings.mirrorLiveHint: MediaPipe FaceLandmarker reads your face from the camera. Frames are analyzed on your GPU locally -- nothing leaves this device.
settings.mirrorModeHint: Copy = avatar mimics your face live. Emotion = avatar reacts to your mood.
settings.model3dHint: Switch to Custom to load your own GLB, GLTF or VRM model.
settings.outputDeviceHint: Playback routing where the browser allows it. Browser voices always use the system default device.
settings.showFaceHint: Show/hide the 3D face model. Uncheck to use only visual effects.
settings.title: LLM Bridge // Settings
settings.ttsEngineHint: On-device TTS: Kokoro is excellent for English; Arabic uses Meta MMS (more robotic than browser Arabic voices).
settings.visemeHint: Press the letter, then hold Preview to make the face mouth that shape: M, O, E, A, S, T, L, K, C, F, U.
settings.visionBackendHint: Auto picks WebGPU YOLO when available, otherwise falls back to COCO-SSD on WebGL.
settings.visionCommentaryHint: When idle, the avatar may comment out loud on what it detects — people, animals, new objects.
settings.visionLiveHint: Detects objects from your camera on-device (YOLO26n via WebGPU, or COCO-SSD fallback). Frames stay on your device.
settings.visionReact: React when a person is detected
settings.visionReactHint: Nudges the avatar into a subtle engaged look while a person is in view.
settings.visualStyleHint: Audio-reactive visual effect behind the face.
settings.voiceKeyHint: Reused automatically if Provider above is already set to Gemini
settings.voiceKeyPlaceholder: Paste your Gemini API key here
settings.voiceLangHint: Used for both speech output and microphone recognition
settings.webllmModelHint: Runs fully in-browser. The model downloads once, then loads from cache. Bigger models need more RAM/VRAM.
settings.whisperTierHint: Bigger models transcribe more accurately but download and run slower on-device.
